message: さっちんのラブラブ大作戦３

name: Nanaka
message: 「How could I possibly do something like that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, Nana-chan, you're such a chicken~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you say?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aah, I guess Nana-chan's overly long crush is finally over too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't just decide it's over on your own!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「But y'know~, Synn-kun seems like he's been hiding something lately, right~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, yeah...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Since it's something he can't even tell you, Nana-chan~, it's definitely got to do with a girl~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way, not Synn, that's...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Give it a rest and stop clinging to that excuse already~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Urgh...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I bet something decisive happened with someone like Ria-senpai~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No way! Even so, that's just...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I wonder about that~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If he were going out with Ria-senpai, Synn would tell me!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sometimes keeping it a secret makes things even hotter, y'know~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that true?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「They might've secretly gotten to first and second base, or maybe even gone all the way to third~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eeeh?! N-No way, that can't be!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If it's come to this, you just gotta get him alone in a dark place and go for a flesh-bullet bliss attack~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is with that weirdly stifling word?!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Turn your own body into a bullet and claim victory in the battle of love~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*G-Gulp*... Specifically, what am I supposed to do...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「In a dark place, you could pretend your stomach hurts and have him rub it~ Or pretend your chest feels tight and have him massage it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I could do something like that!!」
